name: Three.js Runtime Adapter
summary: Embed Three.js and WebGL animation in HyperFrames while keeping scene playback seekable.
problem: Three.js scenes can render differently at arbitrary timestamps when the animation mixer and browser frame loop are not controlled by the composition timeline.
coreOutcomes: Set up a Three.js scene for a HyperFrames composition
Advance animation state from the requested composition time
Validate scene output at arbitrary seek positions
requirements: Three.js and any required WebGL browser support
boundaries: Covers runtime integration rather than general 3D asset creation
WebGL availability and third-party model or texture licensing remain separate requirements
